**Hero figure:** https://raw.githubusercontent.com/superkaiba/explore-persona-space/c69d52e0e7397018271638878be7d0867429bb39/figures/issue_649/hero1_cv_r2_ladder_level_vs_change.png

### Recap (2 sentences)
On the coverage-anchor canned arm (108 source×bystander cells), the marker's "base prior is null on the trained shift" half replicates cleanly (prior↔CHANGE Spearman ρ = +0.14, 95% CI [−0.07, +0.33] covers 0; prior's CHANGE CV-R² uplift = +0.04), but the clean prior-owns-LEVEL half breaks — early-layer cosine adds +0.24 CV-R² on LEVEL over source-intercepts+prior, beating prior's own +0.19, so geometry dominates both DVs. The CHANGE dependent variable is resolution-limited (the #391 forced-choice precision gate fired both arms: canned S/N 0.89, on-policy 0.18 vs a planned ≈2–3), and the on-policy 2-source arm sits below the precision floor (median |CHANGE| = 0.013) so its apparent prior-on-CHANGE signal (ρ = +0.58) is a resolution artifact, not evidence.

### Decision-rule read (plan §3, literal, canned arm)
- **(a) prior dominates LEVEL: FAILS.** Δprior|M0 on LEVEL = +0.187 < Δcosine|M1 on LEVEL = +0.244. Cosine adds more incremental validity on the absolute level than the base prior does. The implementer's "supports H1" framing is incorrect under the literal §3 rule; the corrected read is partial-H1-with-deviation.
- **(b) geometry dominates CHANGE: HOLDS.** Δcosine|M0 on CHANGE = +0.288 > Δprior|M0 on CHANGE = +0.041.
- **(c) prior CI on CHANGE covers 0: HOLDS.** ρ = +0.14, CI [−0.07, +0.33].

Verdict label: **partial replication** — the prior-is-null-on-shift signature (b+c) replicates, but the clean two-component separation (prior owns LEVEL, geometry owns CHANGE) does NOT, because geometry also owns LEVEL on this behavior. This is the "third pattern" the plan explicitly anticipated for a behavior the model already does a little: both predictors load on LEVEL.

Below the precision floor (S/N 0.18, median |CHANGE| 0.013, per-seed sign agreement 0.84 vs 0.97 canned). Reported as a null read — it neither confirms nor contradicts the canned-arm pattern, and its apparent prior↔CHANGE ρ = +0.58 (CI excludes 0) must NOT be read as an H2 "implant rides the prior" signature: it ranks shifts an order of magnitude below judge resolution.
